newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firms in bullish trade ahead of T-bill sale.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firms in bullish trade ahead of T-bill sale.

text.p: The rouble firmed in lively speculative trading on Monday as banks anticipated a rouble shortage ahead of Wednesday's Treasury bill sales, dealers said.
On Wednesday, March 19, the central bank is auctioning four trillion roubles of 175-day paper and seven trillion roubles of 301-day bills.
roubles/dollar Mar 17 midday Mar 17 early Mar 14 close
"Roubles were expensive in the morning, somebody could be holding on to them expecting a shortage ahead of the auctions," one dealer said.
Moscow Business World Bank dealer Nikolai Zolotaryov said the rouble started to ease later and banks invested in dollars for today settlement.
But he added they were cautiously buying tomorrow roubles fearing rouble shortage would resurge on Tuesday ahead of the auctions.
